title: 样本数据 1,1,1,3,3,3 的标准差为？

messages.content:
<details>
<summary>Thinking Process</summary>

```text

We need answer simple. Need comply? User asks standard deviation of sample data 1,1,1,3,3,3. Need decide population vs sample standard deviation? Chinese "样本数据 ... 的标准差" in statistics could mean standard deviation of sample data, often formula s = sqrt(1/n Σ(xi-xbar)^2) in Chinese high school? There is "样本标准差" sometimes s = sqrt(1/(n-1) Σ (xi-xbar)^2) for sample estimating population. But wording "样本数据 1,1,1,3,3,3 的标准差为?" If high school math, "一组数据" standard deviation usually sqrt(variance) with variance = average squared deviations. Need examine.

Data: mean=2. Deviations -1 three times, +1 three times. Sum squares=6. Population variance=6/6=1, sd=1. Sample variance with n-1=6/5=1.2, sd=sqrt(6/5)=√30/5? Actually sqrt(1.2)=sqrt30/5? sqrt(6/5)=sqrt30/5? sqrt(6/5)=sqrt30/5 yes. But "样本数据" maybe if "样本标准差" as unbiased estimator = sqrt(6/5). However many educational contexts "样本数据" just data values; standard deviation = 1. Need maybe mention convention.

Need answer concise. But developer wants three sections? OutputFormat says must contain three parts. For such simple question, maybe include all but concise. Need formula.

Need maybe not overdo. We can say若按高中/描述统计中“这组数据的标准差”定义. If按统计学样本标准差 n-1. Need final maybe: 平均数 2; 方差 (3*(1-2)^2+3*(3-2)^2)/6=1; 标准差=1. If使用样本标准差无偏估计, =√(6/5). Since question likely expected 1.

Need ensure no hidden chain. Final with three sections? "常规解法", "进阶/技巧", "总结". Good.

```

</details>

【常规解法】

数据为：

$$1,1,1,3,3,3$$

平均数为：

$$
\bar{x}=\frac{1+1+1+3+3+3}{6}=2
$$

方差为：

$$
s^2=\frac{3(1-2)^2+3(3-2)^2}{6}
=\frac{3+3}{6}=1
$$

所以标准差为：

$$
s=\sqrt{1}=1
$$

【进阶解法 / 技巧】

这组数据关于平均数 $2$ 对称，且每个数据到平均数的距离都是 $1$。

因此平方偏差和为：

$$
6\times 1^2=6
$$

平均平方偏差为：

$$
\frac{6}{6}=1
$$

所以标准差直接为：

$$
1
$$

【总结与反思】

若按高中阶段通常使用的标准差定义：

$$
\sqrt{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}(x_i-\bar{x})^2}
$$

则答案为：

$$
\boxed{1}
$$

补充：若按统计学中“样本标准差”的无偏估计定义，即除以 $n-1$，则结果为：

$$
\sqrt{\frac{6}{5}}
$$

但本题通常应取：

$$
\boxed{1}
$$
